decisions.name: 阿翔
decisions.reason: Full source pixels viewed: foreground face is angled down under a cap shading the eyes; another prominent person stands left. Even if cropped to one face, the eyes-first reveal would be weak and the face not frontal. Automated detector reported multiple prominent faces. Seek a new frontal single-person source.
